hook: *2.15 lakh* CPS employees and teachers call mass leave on Nov 17
hook_b: *2.15 lakh* CPS employees and teachers call mass leave on Nov 17
tldr: TSCPSEU has called a statewide mass leave on Tuesday, Nov 17, demanding the Contributory Pension Scheme be scrapped and the old pension scheme restored, per Sakshi.

beats.what: Dharna deekshas are planned at all district headquarters.
beats.why: Employees under CPS want a return to the Old Pension Scheme (OPS).
beats.care: Government offices and schools could see thin staff on Nov 17; the report does not say which services are affected.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: No government response is mentioned in the report.

cards.q: Old pension scheme: what's your view?

qs: How many states have returned to the old pension scheme?

facts.t: The union counts *2.15 lakh* CPS employees and teachers statewide.

learn.t: CPS = Contributory Pension Scheme; OPS = old pension paid fully by the government

watch: Whether the government talks to the union before Nov 17.
fact: *2.15 lakh* Telangana employees and teachers plan mass leave on Nov 17
twist: The date marks *three years* since the Congress released its election manifesto, the union says.
